name: clips
description: Automatic game recording and clipping with a private libobs capture engine
author: jss

scripts.stage:runtime: npm run stage:obs && npm run stage:libobs && npm run stage:ffmpeg && npm run stage:mpv && npm run stage:legal
scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/obs.js && node --check src/runtime.js && node --check src/updater.js && node --check src/version.js && node --check src/telemetry.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/logger.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check scripts/env.js && node --check scripts/set-nightly-version.js && node --check scripts/write-worker-config.js && node --check scripts/write-build-info.js && node --check scripts/local-update-server.js && node --check scripts/generate-app-icon.js && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.js && npm --prefix legacy/update-worker run check && npm --prefix legacy/telemetry-worker run check && npm --prefix clips-worker run check
scripts.dist: npm run build:info && npm run stage:legal && electron-builder --config electron-builder.update.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:staged: npm run build:info && npm run stage:legal && electron-builder --config electron-builder.staged.json --win dir && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-staged-update.ps1
scripts.dist:release: npm run dist && npm run dist:staged
scripts.dist:bootstrap: npm run build:info && npm run stage:legal && electron-builder --config electron-builder.bootstrap.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:fresh: npm run stage:runtime && npm run build:mpv-host && npm run build:capture-host && npm run dist:bootstrap
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:info && electron-builder --config electron-builder.bootstrap.json --win portable
